text: Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. One-page site with menu, hours, location and pre-order for pickup. We want a big photo gallery of the cafe AND a detailed story section about each of our three coffee farms. Keep costs low.

The brief is enough to write the charter. Prices, hours, address, photos, farm details and the pre-order destination are not given, so they are open inputs shown as marked placeholders. @Adaptation, please propose workflows.
@Adaptation Charter valid: statement present, 10 checkable done-when items. Work can start.

@Priority Full scope priced on the rate card is 60 against a budget of 35, so I am proposing four small workflows in build order (W1 15, W2 15, W3 10, W4 20). My pick within 35 is W1 + W2 + W3 (40) trimmed by Priority, with the gallery lightbox as the first cut, but I want Priority's counter before reshaping. Trade-off: the brief's two headline asks (gallery and farm stories) cost 30 of the 60, and Priority may need to send the over-budget part to Identity.

proposal.name: Page shell, hours and location
proposal.goal_gap: No page exists: no Brew Lab name, navigation, hours or location.
proposal.expected_outcome: Single HTML file with viewport meta, mobile-first CSS, header naming Brew Lab and Indiranagar, Bengaluru, jump-links to each section, a seven-day hours table and an address block with a map link, all unknowns marked as placeholders.
outputs: index.html with shell, nav, hours and location sections
proposal.completion_check: File opens with no build step; nav links jump to every section; all 7 days are listed; address and map link are present; every unknown value is visibly labelled PLACEHOLDER.

proposal.name: Menu and pickup pre-order form
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot see the menu or pre-order for pickup.
proposal.expected_outcome: A form whose item chooser is the menu, grouped by category with placeholder prices, with quantities, name, phone, pickup time, a running total and a submit that builds an order summary and hands off to a marked placeholder destination. No server.
outputs: Menu and pre-order section added to index.html
proposal.completion_check: Items appear grouped by category; changing a quantity updates the total; submit shows an order summary and a destination labelled PLACEHOLDER; no network backend is called.

proposal.name: Three coffee farm stories
proposal.goal_gap: The page does not tell where the coffee comes from.
proposal.expected_outcome: Three separate farm sections, each with name, location, multi-paragraph story and key details (altitude, variety, process), all marked as placeholders where unknown.
outputs: Three farm story sections added to index.html
proposal.completion_check: Three distinct farm sections exist, each with name, location, at least 2 paragraphs and the three key details, and every unknown is labelled PLACEHOLDER.

proposal.name: Photo gallery with lightbox
proposal.goal_gap: The brief asks for a big cafe photo gallery; none exists.
proposal.expected_outcome: Responsive grid of at least 12 lazy-loaded image slots with alt text and clearly marked placeholder images, opening in a lightbox.
outputs: Gallery section and lightbox added to index.html
proposal.completion_check: At least 12 images in a responsive grid; each has non-empty alt text and loading=lazy; each is marked as a placeholder; clicking opens and closes a lightbox.

text: @Adaptation COUNTER: I fund W1 + W2 (30 of 35). W3 and W4 (30) do not fit, and no part trim gets all four under 35. The 5 left cannot fund a fix (8), so I am not reserving it. Otherwise they go to Identity after the exchanges are used. Cost figures are rate-card prices, not measured spend.
